meta.title: NRP Microcredit — Fast, fair credit in Mozambique
meta.description: Microcredit for small businesses, workers and families in Mozambique. Apply online in a few minutes.

hero.title: The right credit to grow your business
hero.subtitle: Amounts that fit you, clear repayments and a fast answer. No unnecessary paperwork.

products.title: Our products
products.subtitle: Choose the credit that best fits your need.

items.name: Business Credit
items.description: For traders and small entrepreneurs who need stock, equipment or working capital.

items.name: Salary Credit
items.description: For workers with a regular income who need support for one-off expenses.

items.name: Emergency Credit
items.description: Smaller amounts, faster approval, for unexpected health, school or family costs.

steps.title: Apply
steps.text: Fill in the online form in a few minutes.

steps.title: Review
steps.text: Our team reviews your request and calls you.

steps.title: Documents
steps.text: Bring the required documents to one of our branches.

steps.title: Get your credit
steps.text: Once approved, the money is paid in cash, to your bank or mobile wallet.

about.title: About NRP
about.text: NRP Microcredit supports Mozambicans who want to grow: traders, workers and families. We believe in responsible lending, with terms explained simply and personal service.

apply.title: Credit application
apply.subtitle: Fill in your details and we will contact you to continue. Submitting this form is not an automatic approval.

fields.purpose: What will you use the credit for?
fields.consent: I authorise NRP Microcredit to use this information to review my request and to contact me.

apply.successText: Thank you. Our team will call you soon on the number you provided.

errors.generic: We couldn't send your request. Please try again or contact us on WhatsApp.
errors.phone: Enter a valid Mozambican number (9 digits starting with 8).
errors.city: Please enter your city or district.
errors.amount: Enter an amount between 1,000 and 500,000 MZN.
errors.term: Enter a term between 1 and 24 months.
errors.purpose: Briefly describe the purpose (at least 10 characters).
